shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*'"\\.svg' -g '"'!*.png'"' -g '"'!*.jpg'"' | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'head -65 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md'

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination TextInput Select Button Tabs Label Avatar DropdownMenu Modal && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -100 && rg -n 'table|sorting|selection|pagination' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -25 && ls -a | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination TextInput Select Button Tabs Label Avatar DropdownMenu Modal; head -100 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; ls -a | head -25'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInputControl.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts; rg -n 'export interface|items|options|value|onUpdate|filterable|placeholder|render|label|size|title|content' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -45; head -65 node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts; head -150 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js; head -120 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -145; cat index.html; cat tsconfig.json; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(Magnifier|Plus|ArrowDownToLine|ChevronDown|ChevronRight|Xmark|Persons|PersonPlus|CircleCheck|Sliders|ArrowUpRight|CircleQuestion|Bell|Gear|ArrowRightFromSquare|ArrowRotateRight|CircleInfo)\\.' | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md | head -100; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarText/AvatarText.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts; head -130 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css; head -90 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.css; rg -n -- '--g-color-(base|text)-(neutral|positive|info|warning|utility|misc|light|float|generic)|--g-text-(display|header)|--g-border-radius' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -80; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -115"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/icons@2.23.1'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -- '--g-color-base-(warning|brand|float|background)|--g-color-line-(brand|generic)|--g-color-text-(brand|link|dark)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/legacy/Tabs/Tabs.d.ts | head -100; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.js | head -105; rg -n -- '--g-button-(background|text|border)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -15; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ThemeProvider/useTheme.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/metadata.json | head -c 500"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -L --max-time 20 -s -o /tmp/gravity-icons-catalog.html -w '%{http_code}\\n' https://gravity-ui.com/icons; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/legacy/Tabs/TabsItem.d.ts | head -75; rg -n 'useTheme|useThemeType' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.css | head -70; rg -n 'Dots9|CircleDashed|Sun|Moon|Ellipsis|Check|Envelope' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -22"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'Tab' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -25; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Tab/Tab.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TabList/TabList.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TabProvider/TabProvider.d.ts; rg -n -- '--g-color-base-(misc|utility)-light|--g-text-caption-2-font|--g-spacing-7|--g-spacing-8' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -20; git diff --stat"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | rg '/(Tab|TabList|TabProvider)(\\.|/)'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/Tab/Tab.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/TabList/TabList.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/TabProvider/TabProvider.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/Tab.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/TabList.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/TabProvider.d.ts; head -100 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/Tab.css; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/TabList.css | head -65; git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/types.d.ts | head -190; rg -n 'orange-700-solid|orange-650-solid|yellow-650-solid|yellow-700-solid' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -16"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && npx vitest run'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '117,178p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/TabList.js | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/Tab.js | head -75; rg -n -- '--g-text-caption-1-font|--g-text-caption-2-font|--g-text-body-2-font|--g-color-base-generic-ultralight' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -18; cat vite.config.ts; git diff --check"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git diff --check'
